thread:
nina: Quick PR (5120) ready for review: added 'Lenient JSON schema' pattern and a short section on assembling streaming tool outputs. Also updated examples in JS/Python and added a tiny unit test. Would love quick sanity checks on wording + links.

brian: Thanks, pinging @sara for the SDK bits. Heads-up: keep one explicit compatibility snippet for the old /v1/tools users.

sara: Will review. Curious about the lenient schema idea  can you paste the pattern here?

nina: Sure  the core idea is a schema that lists required fields but allows extraProps and uses examples to make parsing easier. Example: ```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "intent": {"type": "string"},
    "payload": {"type": "object"}
  },
  "required": ["intent"],
  "additionalProperties": true
}
```

felix: +1 for additionalProperties:true as a pragmatic default. Also suggest showing a small defensive parse helper using the SDK's parse_structured helper so folks don't reimplement partial-JSON accumulation.

nina: Added this helper snippet to the PR: ```js
// JS streaming assembly using SDK helper
let buf = ''
for await (const chunk of resp.stream()) {
  buf += chunk
  try {
    const out = parse_structured(buf) // tolerant helper
    return out
  } catch (e) {
    // not a complete object yet, continue streaming
    continue
  }
}
```

brian: Small nit: mention the failure mode when model emits trailing commas or commentary tokens. Maybe include a one-line sanitize: `buf = buf.replace(/,\s*}/, '}')` (with a note it's heuristic).

sara: I'll add a Python streaming example and a short warning about using heuristics only as last-resort. Proposed Python: ```py
buf = ''
async for ch in resp.aiter_text():
    buf += ch
    try:
        out = parse_structured(buf)
        break
    except ValueError:
        continue
```

felix: Can we add a test in tests/docs_examples/test_lenient_schema.py that loads the example output (with a trailing comma + extra field) and asserts parse_structured returns the expected keys? Stops regressions.

nina: Added the test and a snapshot fixture. Also fixed two stale links I found: /docs/old-tooling -> /docs/migration/tools-to-functions and /guides/streaming -> /guides/streaming-best-practices.

felix: LGTM. One more doc-consistency nit: call the helper `parse_structured` everywhere (we had parse_structured, structured_parse, mixed). Standardizing avoids confusion.
